## <sub>// 01</sub> About

I'm a final-year Computer Science undergraduate specializing in **AI & Machine Learning**, drawn to the layer where intelligent systems meet low-level engineering. I like projects that make me learn something uncomfortable — writing a hypervisor, wiring up a kernel abstraction in Rust, or getting a multi-agent system to actually cooperate.
